_doc: input: krypciu kodai F B U D DF UF DB UB CIRCLE + paskutinis mygtukas A K G KIAI. frames ms. range: close|mid|midfar|far. level: jodan|chudan|gedan.

techniques.name: Seiken gyaku tsuki
techniques.descLt: Tiesus kumštis į liemenį priešinga ranka.
techniques.descEn: Straight punch to the body with the rear hand.

techniques.name: Seiken oi tsuki
techniques.descLt: Tiesus kumštis į liemenį žengiant pirmyn.
techniques.descEn: Straight punch to the body while stepping forward.

techniques.name: Seiken jodan tsuki
techniques.descLt: Kumštis į galvą. Tik kihon ir kata – kumite metu draudžiama!
techniques.descEn: Punch to the head. Kihon and kata only – forbidden in kumite!

techniques.name: Mae geri chudan
techniques.descLt: Tiesus spyris padu į pilvą.
techniques.descEn: Front kick with the ball of the foot to the stomach.

techniques.name: Chudan uchi uke
techniques.descLt: Vidurinė gynyba – stabdo smūgius į liemenį.
techniques.descEn: Middle block – stops attacks to the body.

techniques.name: Jodan uke
techniques.descLt: Aukšta gynyba – stabdo spyrius į galvą.
techniques.descEn: High block – stops kicks to the head.

techniques.name: Gedan barai
techniques.descLt: Žema gynyba – stabdo žemus spyrius.
techniques.descEn: Low sweeping block – stops low kicks.

techniques.name: Seiken shita tsuki
techniques.descLt: Smūgis iš apačios į pilvą ir šonkaulius.
techniques.descEn: Rising punch to the stomach and ribs.

techniques.name: Seiken kagi tsuki
techniques.descLt: Kabliukas į šoną (šonkaulius).
techniques.descEn: Hook punch to the side of the body.

techniques.name: Gedan mawashi geri
techniques.descLt: Žemas spyris blauzda į šlaunies šoną („low kick“).
techniques.descEn: Low kick with the shin to the side of the thigh.

techniques.name: Hiza geri
techniques.descLt: Kelio smūgis į liemenį iš arti.
techniques.descEn: Knee strike to the body at close range.

techniques.name: Sune uke
techniques.descLt: Žemo spyrio blokavimas pakelta blauzda. Laikyk ↓G, kai skrenda žemas spyris.
techniques.descEn: Low kick check with a raised shin. Hold ↓G when a low kick is coming.

techniques.name: Chudan mawashi geri
techniques.descLt: Šoninis (lankinis) spyris į liemenį.
techniques.descEn: Roundhouse kick to the body.

techniques.name: Yoko geri chudan
techniques.descLt: Spyris šonu, kulnu į liemenį – atstumia varžovą.
techniques.descEn: Side kick with the heel to the body – pushes the opponent back.

techniques.name: Hiji chudan uchi
techniques.descLt: Alkūnės smūgis į liemenį iš arti (tik į liemenį!).
techniques.descEn: Elbow strike to the body at close range (body only!).

techniques.name: Seiken ago uchi
techniques.descLt: Kumštis iš apačios į smakrą. Tik kihon – kumite metu draudžiama!
techniques.descEn: Rising punch to the chin. Kihon only – forbidden in kumite!

techniques.name: Morote uke
techniques.descLt: Dviejų rankų gynyba – stipresnė, bet lėtesnė. Laikyk G.
techniques.descEn: Two-handed block – stronger but slower. Hold G.

techniques.name: Jodan mae geri
techniques.descLt: Tiesus spyris į galvą.
techniques.descEn: Front kick to the head.

techniques.name: Jodan mawashi geri
techniques.descLt: Aukštas šoninis spyris į galvą.
techniques.descEn: High roundhouse kick to the head.

techniques.name: Ushiro geri
techniques.descLt: Atgalinis spyris apsisukant.
techniques.descEn: Spinning back kick.

techniques.name: Kansetsu geri
techniques.descLt: Tiesus spyris į kelį. Tik kihon – kumite metu draudžiama!
techniques.descEn: Straight kick to the knee. Kihon only – forbidden in kumite!

techniques.name: Mawashi uke
techniques.descLt: Apskritiminė gynyba; sėkminga atveria 400 ms kontratakos langą.
techniques.descEn: Circular block; success opens a 400 ms counter window.

techniques.name: Kakato otoshi
techniques.descLt: „Kirvio“ spyris kulnu iš viršaus (oroshi kakato geri).
techniques.descEn: Axe kick with the heel from above (oroshi kakato geri).

techniques.name: Ushiro mawashi geri
techniques.descLt: Sukamasis spyris kulnu į galvą.
techniques.descEn: Spinning heel kick to the head.

techniques.name: Uchi mawashi geri
techniques.descLt: Aukštas spyris iš vidaus į išorę.
techniques.descEn: High crescent kick from the inside out.

techniques.name: Ashi barai
techniques.descLt: Kojos pakirtimas; iškart po jo galima smogti gedan tsuki (↓A).
techniques.descEn: Foot sweep; follow immediately with gedan tsuki (↓A).

techniques.name: Gedan tsuki
techniques.descLt: Kontroliuojamas smūgis į parkritusį iškart po pakirtimo.
techniques.descEn: Controlled punch to the downed opponent right after a sweep.

techniques.name: Tobi mae geri
techniques.descLt: Šuolinis tiesus spyris.
techniques.descEn: Jumping front kick.

techniques.name: Tobi hiza geri
techniques.descLt: Šuolinis kelio smūgis.
techniques.descEn: Jumping knee strike.

techniques.name: Tobi nidan geri
techniques.descLt: Dvigubas šuolinis spyris.
techniques.descEn: Jumping double front kick.

techniques.name: Tobi ushiro mawashi geri
techniques.descLt: Šuolinis sukamasis spyris kulnu.
techniques.descEn: Jumping spinning heel kick.

techniques.name: Kiai
techniques.descLt: 5 s: +25 % žala, ištvermė nesmunka. Reikia pilnos ki juostos.
techniques.descEn: 5 s: +25 % damage, no stamina drain. Needs a full ki bar.
